test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In 2025, which organisation reintroduced the SPREE initiative and launched the Amnesty Scheme – 2025 to expand social security coverage for workers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Employees’ State Insurance Corporation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)** reintroduced the **SPREE (Scheme for Promoting Registration of Employers and Employees)** initiative in early **2025** to enhance formal employment registration.
 
• Alongside this, the corporation launched the **Amnesty Scheme – 2025**, which is specifically designed to provide a one-time window for employers to regularize their records and pay outstanding contributions.
 
• The **Amnesty Scheme – 2025** offers relief to establishments by waiving or reducing the **interest and legal damages** typically levied on the late payment of **ESI contributions**.
 
• The primary goal of the **SPREE 2025** initiative is to bring uncovered workers, especially those in newly notified geographical areas and smaller industrial units, under the social security net of the ESI Act, 1948<
